pgbouncer_ini_path.description: Path to the main pgbouncer configuration file (used in OPTS)

pgbouncer_logfile.description: Path to the log file for PgBouncer.

pgbouncer_pidfile.description: Path to the PID file for PgBouncer.

pgbouncer_listen_addr.description: IP address or * which means all IPs for PgBouncer to listen on.

pgbouncer_listen_port.description: Port number for PgBouncer to listen on.

pgbouncer_unix_socket_dir.description: Directory where the Unix socket is created.

pgbouncer_auth_type.description: Authentication type (any, trust, plain, md5, cert, hba, pam).

pgbouncer_auth_file.description: Path to the file containing user credentials.

pgbouncer_default_db_host.description: Host for the fallback database connect string (*).
